events.title: Japan yen-buying intervention: JPY7,975.6bn
events.summary: MOF reports JPY7,975.6 billion of US-dollar sales and Japanese-yen purchases on July 30, 2026. The November 9 quarterly release allocates JPY15,399.3 billion across July 30, July 31 and August 3.
events.caveat: This is a retrospective official disclosure, not a November 9 intervention. No intraday execution time, causal market effect or US intervention amount is inferred. Holiday observations may be carry-forwards.

events.title: Japan yen-buying intervention: JPY5,552.3bn
events.summary: MOF reports JPY5,552.3 billion of US-dollar sales and Japanese-yen purchases on July 31, 2026. The November 9 quarterly release allocates JPY15,399.3 billion across July 30, July 31 and August 3. A separate August 3 ministerial statement confirms coordination with the US Treasury on July 31, explicitly in US Eastern Time.
events.caveat: This is a retrospective official disclosure, not a November 9 intervention. No intraday execution time, causal market effect or US intervention amount is inferred. Holiday observations may be carry-forwards.
